era.title: Advanced Human Civilization
era.subtitle: Humanity masters the Earth-orbit-Moon-Mars civilization system
era.description: This era marks the rise of mature multi-world civilization across Earth, orbit, the Moon, and Mars, combining space megastructures, lunar cities, Martian industry, advanced medicine, neural presence, and new forms of culture and governance.

seo.metaTitle: Era 5: Advanced Human Civilization | Future Civilization Roadmap
seo.metaDescription: Explore advanced human civilization across Earth, orbit, the Moon, and Mars, including orbital habitats, Moon cities, Mars exports, quantum internet, O'Neill cylinders, and longevity breakthroughs.

items.title: Earth-Moon economy becomes larger than today's global aviation industry
items.description: Trade, logistics, tourism, research, construction, energy, and manufacturing between Earth and the Moon grow into a major economic system larger than today's global aviation industry.
items.civilizationImpact: The Moon becomes an integrated extension of human civilization, transforming space from expeditionary activity into a normal economic domain.
signals: Routine cargo and passenger routes connect Earth orbit and lunar settlements
Lunar industry supplies construction materials, fuel, and research services
Insurance, finance, education, and logistics sectors expand around the Earth-Moon economy
implications: Space infrastructure becomes economically self-reinforcing
Lunar cities gain stronger political and cultural importance
Earth-orbit-Moon logistics becomes a strategic civilization layer
